ZOLA’s customer solution combines small solar PV panels, battery storage, LED lighting, and low-power appliances to create off-grid solutions that provide reliable, convenient, and affordable pre-paid electricity and lighting in the rural and peri-urban markets in Africa. Adaptable to energy need and income, ZOLA Electric’s solar systems can be bought over time using PAYGo micro-finance leasing and mobile money payments. ZOLA Electric powers more than 180,000 homes and businesses across Tanzania, Rwanda, Côte d’Ivoire, Ghana, and Nigeria.
